title: Reports tab: allow selecting contiguous 3-month and 6-month report ranges

requirements.text: Update the Reports page so that when Report Type is set to "3 Months", the user can select a specific contiguous 3-month range (similar to the existing Monthly month/year selector) instead of using a single "Reference Date" date picker.

quotes: error on the reports tab, the option:  report for 3 months i should be able to pick the range of 3 months that i want kinda the same way with the for monthly report, but now for 3 months in row only

acceptanceCriteria: When Report Type = "3 Months", the configuration UI shows a month/year-based selector (not a date input) for choosing the desired 3-month period.
The computed report period covers exactly 3 full consecutive calendar months (inclusive), based on the user’s selection.
The Financial Summary header reflects the correct start and end dates for the selected 3-month range.
No runtime errors occur when switching between Monthly and 3 Months report types.

requirements.text: Update the Reports page so that when Report Type is set to "6 Months", the user can select a specific contiguous 6-month range (similar to the existing Monthly month/year selector) instead of using a single "Reference Date" date picker.

quotes: and for the option print report 6 months report the same way i need the option to pick 6 months in row.

acceptanceCriteria: When Report Type = "6 Months", the configuration UI shows a month/year-based selector (not a date input) for choosing the desired 6-month period.
The computed report period covers exactly 6 full consecutive calendar months (inclusive), based on the user’s selection.
The Financial Summary header reflects the correct start and end dates for the selected 6-month range.
No runtime errors occur when switching between Monthly and 6 Months report types.

requirements.text: Ensure report date-range calculation logic in the Reports page is consistent across Monthly, 3 Months, and 6 Months selections (full-month windows) and does not rely on arbitrary day-based reference dates for multi-month report types.

quotes: i should be able to pick the range of 3 months that i want kinda the same way with the for monthly report

acceptanceCriteria: For Monthly, 3 Months, and 6 Months report types, startDate is the first day of the first selected month and endDate is the last day of the last month in the window (end-of-day).
Switching report types preserves/updates relevant selector state without causing invalid dates or NaN timestamps.
Expenses, revenue, and COGS queries/filtering use the updated start/end timestamps and display correct results for the selected windows.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui (Shadcn components); compose them instead.
Do not edit frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x), frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, or frontend/src/main.tsx (immutable paths).
Keep all backend logic in the existing single Motoko actor; no backend changes are required for this request.
nonGoals: Adding new backend report endpoints or changing backend data schemas.
Changing the printing mechanism beyond ensuring the selected 3- and 6-month ranges are printable with correct dates.
